question: Can native vLLM0.26 Triton faithfully execute real OLMoE inputs with weights mapped into a 384-slot physical pool spanning 21 private and 43 shared locations per layer?
hypothesis: The physical-index domain can exceed the logical model expert count when weights/map/global indexing are configured consistently; this is an interface qualification for a stronger baseline, not a shared-cache performance result.
comparison: Original per-layer same-input reference remains. Shadow compares own same-shaped full64 weights/global64/mapNone against full384 pools/global384/map384 on first min(2,M),min(10,M),min(64,M) distinct rows for each of16 actual layer calls; unchanged original output continues the model.
mapping: Logical experts0..20 map to21*layer_index+[0..20]; experts21..63 map to336..378; other logical indices map-1. Other physical weight rows are NaN. Both real CPU master weight tensors match mapped rows before and after execution byte-for-byte.
negative_control: Only layer0 at10rows: swap the two smallest active logical expert map values before observing negative output. Require finite/not-allclose. Missing M10 or failed fixed control is incomplete/failed, no new pair selection.
conditions: Retain all results; finite/allclose(rtol=.01,atol=.01), exact16 layer coverage, original validation and mapped-row byte equality required. Abort on runtime/source/GPU errors. No performance, quality or bitwise-guarantee claim.
scope: Extra shadow pool/reference/weight byte checks/CPU hashing/GPU synchronization are counted as qualification overhead. This does not implement shared-cache ownership, eviction or cross-layer lifetime. The total384 slot budget is a future steady-state design, not the memory consumption of this qualification.
next_if_pass: Implement minimal fixed-budget shared staging using a declared deterministic private-cache rule and same-stream lifetime, then measure against strong ordinary/static baselines on new inputs.
next_if_fail: Localize physical-map/operator compatibility; do not use invalid mapping or rewrite the failed evidence.
